topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks and Progression
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture objectives, review literature, and the general framework of cancer progression and hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth Factor Signaling and Proliferative Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how oncogenic mutations in surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades drive sustained proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Blocks in Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how arrested cell differentiation contributes to tumor formation across leukemias and colorectal epithelium.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory pathways and mitochondrial mechanisms that allow cancer cells to evade programmed cell death.

topics.label: Telomere Maintenance, Senescence, and Growth Control Summary
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address replicative immortality through telomerase and cellular senescence before concluding the discussion of cell-intrinsic growth control.

topics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming and Oncometabolites in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells alter metabolic pathways such as glycolysis and generate oncometabolites that influence gene expression.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes how growing tumors recruit new vasculature to satisfy their oxygen and nutrient requirements.

topics.label: Mechanisms, Genetics, and Detection of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics outline the steps of the metastatic cascade, seed-and-soil interactions, underlying clonal genetics, and diagnostic tracking methods.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with final remarks on integrating cancer hallmarks and invites student questions.
